sources.title: BARTpho · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BARTpho BARTpho is a large-scale Vietnamese sequence-to-sequence model. It offers a word-based and syllable-based version. This model is built on the BART large architecture with its denoising pretraining. You can find all the original checkpoints under the VinAI organization. This model was contributed by dqnguyen.

sources.snippet: We present BARTpho with two versions, BARTpho-syllable and BARTpho-word, which are the first public large-scale monolingual sequence-to-sequence models pre-trained for Vietnamese.

sources.snippet: BARTpho is a sequence-to-sequence denoising model using the BART architecture, specifically designed and pre-trained for Vietnamese. It is suitable for various natural language processing tasks such as text generation, translation, and summarization.
